title: Essential Chesterfield Bed – Simple Button-Tufted Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Essential Chesterfield Bed is our simplest Chesterfield, with a button-tufted headboard and no wingback or gold trim. If you want the classic Chesterfield bed look at the entry point of the range, this is it, handcrafted in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Chesterfield button-tufted headboard and matching footboard
  • Handcrafted in the UK
  • Solid timber frame with a slatted base for support and ventilation
  • Optional ottoman gas-lift storage
  • Choice of Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen or Crushed Velvet

Sizes and prices

Listed at £309.00. Available in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Please call 07417 439197 to confirm the price for your size before ordering. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Naples, Chenille, Linen and Crushed Velvet. Choose from a wide range of colours. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between the Essential and other Chesterfield beds?

The Essential is our simplest Chesterfield, with no wingback and no gold trim.

Can I add ottoman storage?

Optional ottoman gas-lift storage is available. Call 07417 439197 to confirm the options for this design.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
